mainEntity.name: Why should an optometrist prioritize AI Overviews optimization for their practice?

acceptedAnswer.text: Prioritizing AI Overviews optimization is crucial for optometrists to stay competitive in the evolving digital landscape. As more users rely on these AI-generated summaries for quick answers, practices that appear in these overviews gain significant exposure. This can lead to increased organic traffic, higher patient engagement, and a stronger online presence by establishing the practice as a reliable source of information for eye care, ultimately driving more appointment bookings.
acceptedAnswer.description: Optimizing for AI Overviews helps optometrists gain visibility, attract more patients, and establish their practice as a reliable source of eye care information online.
